authority: LATEST USER CORRECTION: bosses must have no character/person identity; like Part1, they are OBJECTS retaining only defining motifs. Overrides the human-character rendering of v1, even for Iris/captain/vice-captain.
deliverable: 8 single landscape boss concept shots, each one animated object boss in its arena. No modeling sheets, UI, inset, captions or comparison panels.
sharedStyle: Clean stylized 2D fantasy concept art matching Part1 Campanella object-boss reference: broad readable ivory/white/navy/palegold forms, restrained cel shading, strong coherent mechanical silhouette, atmospheric background. Use reference ONLY for material/rendering language, do not copy bell geometry to every boss. No photoreal grit, no microgear clutter.
hardConstraints: Object-first overall silhouette and functional mechanical structure
No humans or people anywhere in frame
No human face, eyes, nose, mouth, hair, skin, beard, facial mask, doll head, mannequin, humanoid robot, human statue or portrait
No two-legged human torso/waist/shoulder anatomy; no hands/fingers/shoes
No character costume, dress, coat, armor worn by a person, saint veil or military uniform
Emotion comes from strain, broken structure, motion and context, never expression
Retain thematic motifs only; do not use v1 human images or actor references as inputs

stages.title: 기억을 흘리는 정찰병
stages.form: A giant cracked GLASS HOURGLASS held in a broad brass cage on FOUR low articulated mechanical outriggers. Hourglass IS the entire body, no head or torso. Golden sand spills from a cracked lower bulb. Two bow-curved crescent rails mounted beside the cage retain ranged/scout function as mechanical launchers, no held bow/hands.
stages.pose: Cage tilts under leaking sand, one support braces forward; clear asymmetrical sentinel machine silhouette.
stages.scene: 45m circular glass arena with three concentric rings, collapsing outer edge sand vortex, golden ceiling sand waterfalls, brass wall gears.

stages.title: 끝나지 않는 진혼곡의 무희
stages.form: An animated RECTANGULAR MUSIC BOX with a spiked pin-barrel/cylinder, rotary cam chassis, huge gold winding key projecting from rear. Four thin mechanical stilts/calipers and two swinging clock-blade fins are driven by visible rods/string linkages. No ballerina doll, dancer figurine, humanoid silhouette, skirts, faces or hands. The MUSIC BOX itself is the boss.
stages.pose: Rotating chassis caught in a strained forced step/oscillation, winding key and mechanical linkages prominent. No human dance pose.
stages.scene: Circular music-box turntable arena, cathedral golden organ pipes and spiked music cylinders, eight note tower pads around perimeter.

stages.title: 얼어붙은 혈관의 연금술사
stages.form: A mobile CRYO-ALCHEMICAL RETORT REACTOR: one large silver-mercury glass flask/reservoir in ivory-gold laboratory cradle on three low support brackets, SIX thick translucent silver conduits as vascular pipe branches. Green healing light pulses in a small glass ampoule/emitter integrated with apparatus. No human alchemist, goggles, coat, arms or hands.
stages.pose: Retort bends within its cradle under pressure; cold silver mercury conduits contrast a small warm green healing pulse.
stages.scene: Platinum-tiled gothic cryo-mercury lab, six silver floor channels and green amplification circles on left and right.

stages.title: 영원히 타오르는 가마의 수호자
stages.form: A massive animated FURNACE BULWARK/GATE: squat armored kiln housing with glowing molten-gold core, shield-shaped massive hinged front rampart integrated into the furnace, broad mechanical ground braces instead of legs. EIGHT red-hot cooling chains anchor chassis to eight surrounding pillars. No knight, head, arms or held shield.
stages.pose: Integrated shield-gate lifts/angles protectively to create sheltered space behind the object while chassis strains against eight chains.
stages.scene: Octagonal metal-grate platform over molten gold sea inside enormous clocktower furnace, eight cooling-chain pillars.

stages.title: 무너진 천구를 떠받치는 부단장
stages.form: An animated LOAD-BEARING ASTROLABE mechanism: colossal circular bearing hub and tripod/triangular scaffold, giant golden HOUR-HAND SPEAR functions as the structural spine/strut supporting collapsing celestial rings. Two opposed mechanical calipers lock one another to prevent a destructive release. No knight, face, monocle, hair, uniform, shoulders or human arms.
stages.pose: Hour-hand strut and bearing bow beneath huge cracked celestial ceiling; opposed calipers show the last protective resistance. Single coherent structural object.
stages.scene: Black obsidian star-chart arena, broken dark I-IV and blue V-XII markings, huge brass astrolabe rings and frozen cosmos.

stages.title: 구원받은 인형, 이리스
stages.form: A broken WHITE PORCELAIN TEA RELIQUARY/TEAPOT-CASING enclosing a visible gold CLOCK HEART. Exactly SIX broad sharp golden clock-hand vanes radiate from its back rotor, three per side. One large golden cutting clock-blade on the left side of the apparatus is restrained by a delicate two-jaw white/brass CALIBRATION CLAMP on the other side. The clamp is a mechanical tool, never a human hand. Small navy/blue flower decal only as tea-service memory. No doll, saint figure, veil, face, hair, body, arms, fingers or dress.
stages.pose: Porcelain vessel floats or rests on three short instrument supports, six vanes separated and wholly framed, fine clamp arrests heavy blade below visible clock heart.
stages.scene: White marble cathedral arena, gold second-index marks, a few petrified teacups floating in air; cold ivory/gold with navy shadows.

stages.title: 과거에 갇힌 선대 단장
stages.form: An animated BLACK MIRROR ENGINE: one large upright cracked mirror panel in a coherent gold gimbal/three-bracket stand, a giant MINUTE-HAND GREATSWORD shape is integrated as the rotating spine/edge, not carried. Half the mirror frame and mechanism dissolves into golden sand. Mirror panes reflect ONLY empty warm blue-sky training-ground architecture, no people or faces. No captain, hair, beard, cloak, arms, hands or human outline.
stages.pose: Mirror mechanism leans/opens as if offering the familiar memory while one half erodes, mechanical joints maintain one mobile object.
stages.scene: Black mirror arena with clock minute hand near11:59, floating mirror fragments reflecting warm training-ground scenery against dark present.

stages.title: 제13시의 신, 아페이론
stages.form: A COLOSSAL SHATTERED XIII COSMIC CLOCK/ORRERY, a pale broken circular clock disk and dark star-void core suspended inside massive gold gimbal rings. Roman 'XIII' is clearly readable on main core. Radial gear-driven calipers and clock-hand rails grip a giant hand trying to rewind time. No divine human, head, hair, face, torso, limbs, human hands, robe or angel body. The clock apparatus itself is the god-object.
stages.pose: Monumental tilted cosmic clock mechanism above rooftop; giant clock-hand bridge leads to central XIII core, gimbal supports and shattered pieces form coherent circular apparatus.
stages.scene: 50m gold rooftop clock arena above clouds, midnight cosmos/black solar eclipse on one side and golden dawn on the other.

notes: Only object motifs of the narrative remain in the visual designs. Do not read the old v1 actor-identity instructions as active. Keep v1 files preserved as earlier rejected direction; deliver this v2 separately.
